PreviewResult.description: No original request echo. sanitized_request is ephemeral; never auto-persist. blocked always sanitized_request=null. Preview uses HTTP200 for evaluated decision; transport malformed API envelope uses400. Gateway failures use blocking HTTP statuses.

x-gateway-contract.before_upstream: fully inspect/rewrite/validate and commit risk decision before connection
x-gateway-contract.errors: safe Error schema; no original values; zero upstream requests
x-gateway-contract.response_stream: unchanged after successful request inspection; no model-output scanning
